tasks.short: Counsel clients about dependencies and life changes

steps.what: Read the actual client history and current concerns before counseling
Counsel clients individually or in groups about dependencies and desired changes

tasks.design: Retain direct counseling and separate reading of the existing client record in {OTHER}. Test the native case view first; it already supplies relevant history here, while personal understanding and therapeutic conversation remain necessary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counseling depends on trust, contextual judgement and response to the actual client.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case access supports preparation without replacing therapeutic work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising distress, ambivalence and risk without making unsupported inferences.
tasks.human_edge: Build a therapeutic relationship and adapt the conversation responsibly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substance-use counseling requires contextual client-history review and personal therapeutic interaction.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is the counseling encounter and its work reading. OTHER is the clinical case-record application. Client-history production and required progress records are separately decomposed in task 5584, not treated as nonexistent or free new staff work.

Before zero, inspect preparation, lookup, record and send work: history reading is s1; actual record production is assigned to 5584 in this answer; no duplicate record step is added here. An actual referral or client message needs its own counted action when present.
Native case access is assessed first and already direct. No template removes fresh clinical reading or conversation. No transcript, new recording capture or ongoing automation is proposed.
unknowns: Actual additional referral or messaging duties in counseling
research_questions: Observe counseling and allocate actual documentation once to the record task, checking for separate referrals.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed for the encounter

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 15 history-reading and 85 counseling points. A complex dependency case requires full personal preparation; actual documentation is assessed separately in 5584 and cannot be credited twice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual training objectives and participant instructions
Attend training sessions and practice the relevant counseling knowledge and skills

tasks.design: Keep actual training participation and separately counted instruction reading. Native course access in {LMS} already supplies the materials in this attendance scenario; a model cannot acquire the counselor's skills on their behalf.
tasks.previous_blocker: The counselor must personally learn and practice new professional skills.
tasks.enabler_now: Native learning access provides materials but establishes no additional labour-removing work here.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding and applying new approaches responsibly in client care.
tasks.human_edge: Practice, reflect and recognise limits of competence.
tasks.altitude: No change to professional learning responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: attending professional training requires the participant's learning and practice; existing automatic completion records are system runtime, not new labour savings.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an assigned session with direct material access, not finding and booking the next external course. The training provider supplies objectives; participant reading remains counted.

Before zero, inspect course lookup, enrollment, required reflections and certificate submission. None is established in this attendance-only task. Any actual manual booking or required written reflection must be separately added and assessed rather than assumed absent from a broader training workflow.
Native course access comes first. No new progress log or free recording is introduced, and no automatic completion runtime is counted as human work. No implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Any actual booking or written reflection included in this task
research_questions: Observe a training session and identify real participant-owned lookup, enrollment or submission work.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 instruction-reading and 90 attendance/practice points. An unfamiliar counseling method still needs full participant learning; no actual duplicate record or send is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review client histories, relevant research and clinical experience for treatment planning
Discuss treatment goals and constraints with the client
Determine the clinically appropriate individual treatment plan
Write the actual client treatment plan from the counselor's decisions

loop.purpose: Restate the counselor's own treatment decisions without proposing care
loop.input: Counselor-authored goals, interventions, responsibilities and review dates
loop.check: Counselor checks clinical meaning, omitted limits, risk statements, patient preferences and that every intervention was personally chosen
loop.stop: Unsupported risk, invented intervention or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native plan fields come first; limited variable rationale prose needs bounded drafting, not treatment recommendation

steps.what: Check the complete treatment plan and retain it in the clinical record

tasks.design: Test native treatment-plan fields in the clinical application in {OTHER} first. A bounded draft restates the counselor's own decisions, while clinical assessment, client discussion, complete plan checks and ordinary record saving remain with the counselor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recording a treatment plan requires restating decisions after the clinical work is done.
tasks.enabler_now: Limited source-bound drafting can assist plan wording without choosing treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Matching care to clinical needs, evidence and the client's preferences.
tasks.human_edge: Choose treatment and recognise when additional clinical support is needed.
tasks.altitude: Less plan restatement with unchanged clinical decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can restate counselor-specified plan content, but clinical treatment decisions and patient preferences require professional review.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is treatment-plan development and its original clinical record, not a referral or outward patient send. OTHER is the clinical case application; the care team actually uses the treatment plan.

The counselor reviews history and research in s1 and supplies client ID, goals, chosen interventions, responsibilities, review date and limitations through s2-s4. This input and missing-evidence work remain counted; no new recording or transcript is assumed.

Native plan fields come first. Only 4 of 20 prose-restatement points are removed; 16 retain input, specialist writing and failed-draft repair, plus complete checks in s5. Excess repair lowers benefits.

s5 is full clinical verification and an ordinary author save, fully retained and ungated. It is not a formal independent approval or separate patient communication. No model chooses or activates care.
unknowns: Actual plan-writing effort and application access
research_questions: Compare a real plan draft against the counselor's decisions, including missing risks and altered responsibilities.

incremental.description: Maintain plan instructions and review recurring clinical wording errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 4 restatement points less 0.8 upkeep. A complex co-occurring condition requires bespoke clinical writing; reuse only 1 point of already-decided goal wording: 1 minus 0.8 = 0.2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain accurate patient histories, progress and service records

steps.what: Verify actual client history, progress and services provided from the encounter
outputs: checked record facts and counselor assessment

steps.what: Write the required patient history, progress and service entry
inputs: checked record facts and counselor assessment

loop.purpose: Restate the counselor's supplied encounter facts and assessment
loop.input: Checked facts, service details and counselor-authored clinical assessment
loop.output: Draft progress entry with fact references
loop.check: Counselor checks attribution, chronology, omissions, negation, clinical meaning and every risk statement against actual supplied facts
loop.stop: Invented risk, missing source or two failed drafts returns the entry to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native record fields come first; variable progress narrative needs bounded drafting rather than a fixed form

steps.what: Check the complete entry, correct clinical meaning and save the ordinary case record
inputs: checked record facts and counselor assessment

tasks.design: Test native record templates in the clinical application in {OTHER}, then draft variable progress prose only from counselor-supplied facts and assessment. Retain fact capture, complete meaning checks and the normal same-system record save; do not add conversation recording or automate clinical decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual case records require repetitive narrative restatement after the encounter.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded note drafting can restate supplied facts when the counselor checks the complete entry.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding altered negation, attribution or unsupported risk statements.
tasks.human_edge: Own the accurate clinical account and distinguish observation from assessment.
tasks.altitude: Less routine note restatement with unchanged clinical record accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded clinical-note drafting from supplied facts requires full checking of clinical meaning, omissions and risk statements; no local saving is established by that capability alone.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is the existing original clinical record maintained for care, not a new activity report. OTHER is the clinical case application. Record work from counseling is counted here once; treatment-plan development in 5585 is distinct and excluded.

The counselor supplies client ID, encounter date, actual services, observations, client-attributed statements and their own assessment in s1-s2. Capture, input and missing-fact repair remain fully counted. No free transcript, new dictation duty or validated upstream summary is assumed.

Native templates are tested first. Only 9 of 45 writing points are removed; 36 retain fact input, specialist writing and draft repair, plus 25 full-check points. More error correction than that allowance lowers benefits.

s3 combines complete clinical review with an ordinary author save. The save is fully retained and ungated, earning no saving. An actual external report, referral or formal third-party release must be separately counted and gated if present.
unknowns: Permitted data access and existing templates
research_questions: Compare drafted and manually written real entries for negation, attribution, omitted facts and invented risks, counting input and correction time.

incremental.description: Maintain record-draft instructions and inspect recurring meaning errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 9 writing points less 1.2 upkeep. Complex histories and multiple dependencies require mostly bespoke clinical prose; reuse only 2 points of factual service-description wording: 2 minus 1.2 = 0.8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect counseling and clinical decisions while reducing limited verified restatement in actual treatment plans and progress records.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous counseling, treatment selection or additional record requirement is proposed.

job.title: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
